newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Monday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reported light to moderate inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - 56,500 Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 33,700 Week Ago - 82,100 Year Ago - 25,000

Movement for the week to date at 33,700 head included 33,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was $62.00 per cwt on Friday. Monday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices $64.00-$66.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
